families.label: Configure through the product's own connector settings, then each user connects from Customize > Connectors

variants.label: Team/Enterprise: owner adds M365 org-wide, then members connect
preconditions: Owner or Primary Owner role on a Team or Enterprise plan
Global Administrator access to the Microsoft Entra tenant
work or school Microsoft account on an Entra tenant (personal accounts unsupported)
active Microsoft 365 accounts for all users
steps: Admin: navigate to Organization settings > Connectors
Select Add, then All available
Find Microsoft 365 and select "Add to your team"
Connect individually and grant organization-wide permissions
Optionally restrict user access or revoke specific permission scopes
Member: navigate to Customize > Connectors
Find Microsoft 365 and click "Connect"
Authenticate with Microsoft 365 credentials
variants.notes: The page labels these Phase 1 (admin) and Phase 2 (user) of one setup; merged as sequential stages of a single path.

variants.label: Free/Pro/Max: user connects directly, no organization-level setup
preconditions: Free, Pro, or Max plan
a Microsoft Entra Global Administrator has granted the one-time tenant consent for the Microsoft organization
steps: Navigate to Customize > Connectors in claude.ai
Find Microsoft 365 and click "Connect"
Authenticate with Microsoft 365 credentials
variants.notes: Same user steps as P1a with the admin phase skipped; stated in the Setup requirements prose and in the Phase 2 record's notes rather than as its own numbered procedure.

variants.label: Remote connector: Entra consent, desktop app registration and Anthropic allowlisting, configured in the in-app configuration window
preconditions: Global Administrator or Cloud Application Administrator in the Entra tenant
Claude Desktop deployed on third-party inference
Anthropic allowlists the tenant and client IDs (two to three business days)
FedRAMP/GovCloud deployments need a different connector app ID and hostname from an Anthropic representative
steps: Copy the Directory (tenant) ID from Entra admin center > Overview
Open the adminconsent URL for that tenant with Anthropic's connector client_id, review the delegated read-only Graph permissions, and select Accept
In App registrations > New registration, register a desktop client app (this directory only) with redirect URI http://127.0.0.1/callback under Mobile and desktop applications
Select Register and note the Application (client) ID and Directory (tenant) ID
Under API permissions, add the Anthropic API delegated permission access_as_user and select Grant admin consent for your organization
Email the Directory (tenant) ID and Application (client) ID to your Anthropic representative or support and wait for allowlist confirmation
Open the Claude Desktop in-app configuration window and open Connectors
Select Add server > Microsoft 365 and enter the Client ID, Tenant ID, and the access_as_user offline_access scope string
Select Save and deploy the configuration through your device-management tool
Each user opens Customize > Connectors in Claude Desktop and selects Connect next to Microsoft 365
The user signs in on the tenant's sign-in page in the browser and consents
variants.notes: Entra consent, app registration, allowlisting, desktop configuration, and user sign-in merged into one path; the reader chooses between this in-app configuration and the managed file of P2a.

variants.label: Local connector: dedicated public client app in Entra, built-in M365 server configured in the in-app configuration window
preconditions: Microsoft Entra admin center access
a separate app registration dedicated to local mode (do not reuse the remote connector's desktop client app)
brokered sign-in needs Claude Desktop 1.13576.0 or later on Windows, 1.19367.0 or later on macOS
the built-in server activates only from managed configuration; users cannot add it themselves
steps: In Entra admin center > App registrations > New registration, register a public client app for local mode with Supported account types set to this directory only
Under Authentication > Redirect URI configuration, add http://localhost under the Mobile and desktop applications card
For brokered sign-in on managed devices, add the per-platform broker redirect URI to the same platform via Edit and Save
Set Allow public client flows to Yes and Save; block the device-code flow with a Conditional Access policy scoped to All resources
Under API permissions > Microsoft Graph > Delegated permissions, add the scopes the connector will request and select Grant admin consent
Note the Application (client) ID and Directory (tenant) ID from the overview page
In the Claude Desktop in-app configuration window, open Connectors, select Add server, and choose Microsoft 365 under the Built-in group
Enter the Tenant ID and Client ID, choose the Azure cloud (global, us-gov-high, or us-gov-dod), and leave Access empty or list scopes explicitly
Select Test connection to verify the server starts and lists its tools, then Save and deploy the configuration

For brokered sign-in, meet the platform device requirements: Entra join or registration and compliance on Windows; MDM enrollment, Intune Company Portal, and an Extensible SSO Redirect profile on macOS
Each user opens Customize > Connectors in Claude Desktop and selects Connect on Microsoft 365
The user completes sign-in in the broker's system account-picker dialog, or in the system browser when the broker is unavailable
variants.notes: The Windows and macOS brokered sign-in requirement accordions are folded in as one optional step of the sign-in stage rather than kept as separate procedures.

families.label: Declare the connector in managedMcpServers in the managed JSON or plist and deploy it

variants.label: Remote connector declared in managedMcpServers by URL and transport
preconditions: Global Administrator or Cloud Application Administrator in the Entra tenant
configuration managed through JSON or a plist instead of the in-app configuration window
tenant and client IDs allowlisted by Anthropic
steps: Copy the Directory (tenant) ID from Entra admin center > Overview
Open the adminconsent URL for that tenant with Anthropic's connector client_id, review the delegated Graph permissions, and select Accept

In App registrations > New registration, register a desktop client app (this directory only) with redirect URI http://127.0.0.1/callback under Mobile and desktop applications, and note its Application (client) ID
Under API permissions, add the Anthropic delegated permission access_as_user and select Grant admin consent for your organization
Email the Directory (tenant) ID and Application (client) ID to Anthropic and wait for allowlist confirmation
Open the managed configuration JSON or plist
Add a managedMcpServers entry named m365 with the connector service URL and transport http
Set oauth.clientId to the Application (client) ID and oauth.tenantId to the Directory (tenant) ID
Set oauth.scope to the access_as_user offline_access scope string
Deploy the configuration through your device-management tool
Each user opens Customize > Connectors in Claude Desktop, selects Connect next to Microsoft 365, signs in on the tenant page, and consents
variants.notes: Same Entra stages and user sign-in as P1c; it differs at the configuration stage, which is the stage the reader chooses on, so it is a separate family.

variants.label: Local built-in connector declared in managedMcpServers with server set to microsoft365
preconditions: configuration managed through JSON or a plist directly
a local-mode app registration with its Application (client) ID and Directory (tenant) ID
microsoftAuthBroker required only where every device runs Claude Desktop 1.49585.0 or later; required is unsupported on Linux
steps: Register a separate public client app for local mode in Entra (this directory only); do not reuse the remote connector's desktop client app
Under Authentication, add http://localhost, plus the per-platform broker redirect URI for brokered sign-in, under Mobile and desktop applications
Set Allow public client flows to Yes and Save
Add the Microsoft Graph delegated scopes under API permissions, select Grant admin consent, and note the Application (client) ID and Directory (tenant) ID
Open the managed JSON or plist configuration
Add a managedMcpServers entry with server set to microsoft365 and set name, clientId, and tenantId
Optionally set azureCloud, continuousAccessEvaluation, scope, and toolPolicy; do not mix url, transport, or command into a built-in entry
Set microsoftAuthBroker to auto, disabled, or required to choose between the device broker and the system browser
Deploy the configuration through your device-management tool
For brokered sign-in, meet the Windows or macOS device requirements (Entra join or MDM enrollment and compliance, Intune Company Portal and an Extensible SSO Redirect profile on macOS)
Each user opens Customize > Connectors in Claude Desktop and selects Connect on Microsoft 365
The user completes sign-in in the broker's account-picker dialog, or in the system browser when the broker is unavailable
variants.notes: The microsoftAuthBroker record and the Windows/macOS brokered sign-in requirement records are sub-options of this path's configuration and sign-in stages, folded in rather than split out.

claude.note: Only the product's own settings are involved: an owner adds the connector org-wide on Team/Enterprise, or the user connects directly on Free/Pro/Max; the Entra tenant consent is assumed rather than walked through.

claude-desktop-3p.note: Adds an Entra app-registration stage in third-party-admin, a choice of remote vs local connector, a managed-file alternative to in-app configuration, and Anthropic allowlisting on the remote path.

claude-gov.note: Referenced only indirectly: FedRAMP/GovCloud use a different connector app ID and hostname, and the local connector takes azureCloud us-gov-high or us-gov-dod, but no Gov-specific procedure is documented.

summary: Two products document M365 setup: claude.ai admin-then-user connect, and third-party-inference Desktop with Entra registration plus in-app or managed-file configuration.
open_questions: The microsoftAuthBroker record and the two brokered sign-in requirement records do not meet the task outcome on their own; they were folded into the local-connector variants as sub-options of the configuration and sign-in stages rather than misfiled, because the page presents them inside the same local-connector path. A stricter reading would drop the microsoftAuthBroker record as a configuration-key reference rather than a procedure.

The local connector's optional toolPolicy field and explicit scope list restrict which tools members can invoke, which is T-023's outcome; that was kept as one optional step inside P2b instead of being split out as a T-023 record.

The Phase 1 admin record's own outcome (connector added for the team with organization-wide permissions) also matches T-022; it is retained here because the page frames it as Phase 1 of this two-phase setup and the task outcome is only reached with Phase 2.
P1b (Free/Pro/Max direct connect) rests on the Setup requirements prose and the Phase 2 record's notes, not a separately numbered procedure; it could instead be treated as a precondition note on P1a.
No record says whether claude-web or claude-desktop differ from the undistinguished claude path, or whether claude-gov follows the same procedure with a different connector app ID.
